newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat shares have 20 pct upside--broker.
newsitem.headline: Fiat shares have 20 pct upside--broker.

text.p: Shares in Italian industrial group Fiat SpA have a potential upside of 20 percent to 5,200 lire a share, said a research note by MC-BBL broker in collaboration with Aletti & C Sim.

The authors of the report Dagmar Bottenbruch and Miriam Bauer added that even this valuation was conservative and they see 6,000 lire as a more appropriate price. Their calculations do not include a potential capital gain from the planned partial float of agricultural machinery division New Holland.

Fiat shares hit a fresh year low of 4,020 lire as the market fretted about the depressed nature of the Italian car market and the effect of the strong lira. The share ended off 2.94 percent at 4,024 lire.
